assumptions_requiring_adjudicator_confir: C-05, C-02, and F-16 are not survivors today. Each enters the candidate set only after a genuine G7 repair, authoritative P4 amendment, and fresh red team; none may be counted before then.

The eight provisional sub-$100k entries are decisive business-and-technical experiments, not renamed discovery tasks. Their access, paid-counterparty, benchmark, and kill conditions must be incorporated into the final experiment text.

A commercial experiment may satisfy the decisive-first-experiment quota when the merchant socket or data-rights question is the dominant existential risk; it may not be used when an unresolved high-cost physics demonstration remains equally existential.

All formal China flags retained in the count require country-specific evidence and a lawful product route. In particular, F-01 and A-10 require replacement of restricted-account logic; C-13 requires a screened buyer other than Raycus; F-23 requires chemistry-matched China evidence; and F-02 requires official end-use screening.

B-01, C-08, C-04, F-12, G-03, G-01, F-23, and F-03 remain conditional despite helping portfolio arithmetic; if their red-team gate failures are upheld, they must be replaced rather than carried for quota value.

The product-role normalization is semantic only: metrology/test products are diagnostic_test; infrastructure power/thermal/protection products are infrastructure; products operating in big-science systems are scientific_system; and production-controlling/converting hardware is process_output.

The customer-archetype normalization follows the immediate paying customer, not the ultimate beneficiary: industrial OEM/fabricator/operator, scientific/big-physics lab or program, or infrastructure/utility/transport owner/integrator.

The formal 24 identified 2028-or-earlier experiments and 24 procurement/design-in paths are planning statements, not secured counterparties. At least eight paths must be backed by specific named counterparties and an engagement mechanism before final selection.
Top-10 membership for C-05 and C-02 is conditional on revival; if either fails, D-19 is the first replacement and F-02 is the second.
No excluded geography is used as a buyer, beachhead, market input, or entry route. Optional side markets remain secondary only.

The adjusted red-team scores are used for ordering where available; P4 scores are retained for C-05, C-02, and F-16 only as historical values and must not be compared as if those ideas had passed a fresh red team.
A final portfolio should prefer an honest FAIL over preserving exactly 24. If the repair conditions cannot be closed with fetched eligible evidence, P5 is blocked rather than compliant.
